_comment: Custom configuration template. Copy to custom_patterns.json and modify as needed.
_usage: analyzer.py auto-loads custom_patterns.json (if it exists) from ~/.config/ai-interaction-analyzer/ or the config/ directory.
extra_confirmations: Example: add your common short confirmation phrases here to avoid false-positive low-quality detection
extra_followups: Example: add your common follow-up sentence patterns here (regex supported)
extra_negations: Example: add your unique negation/redo expressions here
ignored_projects: Example: project names you don't want analyzed
